label: How each IGF fuel is kept on board, on one temperature scale: hydrogen as a liquid at about -253 °C, LNG at about -162 °C, LPG and ammonia refrigerated at about -42 °C and -33 °C (or under pressure at room temperature), and at room temperature CNG as a gas compressed to 200-250 bar and methanol and ethanol as liquids.

markers.label: CNG, methanol, ethanol
markers.note:
room temperature: CNG a gas at 200-250 bar,
methanol and ethanol liquids

steps.title: 1 · Hydrogen - the coldest: a liquid only near -253 °C
2 · LNG - a cryogenic liquid at about -162 °C
3 · LPG - refrigerated, or kept liquid under pressure
4 · Ammonia - refrigerated or under pressure, and toxic
5 · CNG, methanol and ethanol - kept at room temperature
